Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim file purposes. Can you state your full
name for the record?
A: I'd rather just go by my initials for now, if that's okay. It's the same thing, right?
Q: That's fine for the purposes of this statement. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was stopped at a light on the main road heading into town, in Conroe. I had been waiting a little while because
traffic was backed up.
Q: Okay. What happened next?
A: The light was still red, and then all of a sudden I felt this hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then
forward. I didn't even see the car coming. My foot was on the brake the whole time.
Q: Did you see the vehicle that hit you before the impact?
A: No. I was looking at the light and the cars in front of me. I just heard tires and then the impact.
Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: Yes, I got out and walked around for a minute. My neck was already stiff and my lower back started to ache within
an hour or so.
Q: Have you sought any medical attention since the accident?
A: I went to urgent care the same day, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then. The doctor
said it's a neck and back strain. I'm still having trouble turning my head to the right and sitting for long periods.
Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness in those areas before this accident?
A: Not that I can recall. I had normal days before this happened, and I was working full shifts without much trouble.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Just that I want to get back to normal as soon as I can. I'm following everything my providers told me to do.
Q: Thank you for your time today.
</page>
